meaning: Materials supply to an active works has stalled
keep: Registered alarm title; not imminent dated loss
binding_note: Existing alarm registry title copied exactly; preserve rank and yellow state

text_ru: Материалы на складе. Стройка: {unit}. Рабочих суток без подвоза: {amount}.
meaning: The named works has had no material deliveries for the counted working days
intent: Show the stalled supply and its measured duration
keep: Working days not calendar days or labor_days; amount is idle-day count; no guaranteed completion date
binding_note: AlarmState.unit -> ready nominative works name; amount -> supply_idle_days count; do not use days_to_loss or invent a weather deadline

text_ru: Поставьте подвоз на эту стройку перед полевыми работами. На полевые работы останется меньше подвод.
meaning: Prioritizing this site's supply diverts available carters ahead of field jobs
intent: Explain the offered supply priority and its cost
keep: Supply priority not a new worker assignment; no free extra carts or promised instant delivery
binding_note: Only advice=kSupplyOverFields; target AlarmState.logistics_task; not unit as the door subject; suppress when kNone/already over_fields

meaning: The existing raise-site order for an active works
intent: Name the registered reversible priority control
keep: Not the separate supply-over-fields order; no change of tier
binding_note: OrderKind.kRaiseSite; Order.unit is the active site; enable=1; key/surface registration by boss

text_ru: Стройка поднимется внутри своей очереди: раньше получит людей и подвоз материалов. Другие стройки будут ждать дольше.
meaning: Workers and supply for this works rank ahead within the existing tier
intent: Explain the two effects and their displacement cost
keep: Tier unchanged; no universal priority above all urgent work; no satisfaction charge invented
binding_note: Same unit and enable=1; active delivery/build/repair/upgrade/module only; no promise to outrank an older already-raised site

text_ru: {family}: при годовом разделе списан долг по авансу — {amount} в пересчёте на зерно.
meaning: A new household's remaining advance debt is written off at the annual share-out
intent: Report the completed write-off without blaming the household
keep: Not cash; grain-equivalent amount; no new payment issued or district loan forgiven
binding_note: kAdvanceWrittenOff kNotable; family -> saved family display name in nominative; amount -> formatted grain-equivalent grams with weight unit

text_ru: {field}: {resource} вывозят раньше остальных работ — запас сена на исходе.
meaning: Hay carting from the named meadow takes priority because accessible hay is running out
intent: Report the urgent work choice without decoding telemetry
keep: Only field and resource; action in progress not cargo already delivered; one village-day event
binding_note: kStackCartUrgent kNotable; field/resource -> nominative display names; amount is PACKED internal data and must not become a quantity or deadline

text_ru: {herd}: корм взят из другого запаса. Место: {unit}.
meaning: The herd consumed feed supplied from another unit's stock
intent: Give one neutral short record of the actual source
keep: No cart trip invented; no owner/family blamed; no telemetry unpacked
binding_note: kHerdAteFromFarRick kRoutine; herd/unit -> nominative display names; only when unit is valid; amount is packed and not bound

intent: Avoid an empty or fabricated place in the permitted unset-unit case
keep: No invented source unit or cart transport
